exposure: pregnancy status (pregnant, not pregnant but had given birth, never pregnant/given birth)
outcome: knowledge of the effect of exercise during pregnancy
perceptions of the effect of exercise during pregnancy
cohort: A cohort of 291 women, aged 18-55 years, categorized by their pregnancy status: pregnant, not pregnant but had given birth in the past, or never pregnant and never given birth.
finding: Only 24.4% of respondents were aware of the effect of exercise in pregnancy, and women who were not pregnant but had given birth were significantly less aware of the effect of exercise than women who were pregnant or had never given birth.
cross-section timing: Current pregnancy status (pregnant, not pregnant but had given birth previously, or never pregnant/given birth) at the time of the survey.
